nodes.name: psychology_check_contract
psychology_policy
Realization follows a settled observation and performs no new roll
Settle one concealed Psychology observation
Bind a player-safe realization of a settled Psychology observation; the decision has no roll path and public output is external_behavior only
Psychology can see through Disguise (opposing_notes); psychology_check_contract compiles only the four interpersonal skills
Keeper-authored player-visible external-behavior prose
Host-attached frozen inference ceiling from the concealed settlement
Host-grounded observable fact refs for the observation
Observer Psychology skill value (sheet); missing skill uses resolver-owned PSYCHOLOGY_BASE_CHANCE
Player-source concrete observation question
Host-selected relevant opposing social skill of the target (Intimidate, Fast Talk, Persuade, or Charm); 90+ is Extreme
Psychology observation
Psychology base chance is resolver-owned PSYCHOLOGY_BASE_CHANCE (Keeper Rulebook 10%); the graph references it and must not carry it
Psychology rolls may be concealed; the Keeper announces only the information gained, true or false
Reading intent is Regular below 50 opposing social skill, Hard at 50 to 89, Extreme at 90 or higher (90+ from the social ladder)
Psychology opposes Charm, Fast Talk, Intimidate, and Persuade
Psychology can also reveal a disguised individual (Disguise skill)
Die, outcome, settlement identity, question, observable facts, and inference ceiling stay Keeper-only
Player-safe realization public output is exactly {external_behavior}

Which information a concealed Psychology roll yields is not encoded in skill-descriptions (rolls may reveal information 'true or false, that the user gained...'); the fixture's success-reveals-truth mapping stays uncompiled
